test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 15 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In which of the Five-Year Plans, was the main slogan 'towards Faster and more inclusive growth' used?
solution:
The Correct answer is__** 11th**__**.**

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Manmohan Singh** served as leader during 11th five year plan's tenure, which lasted from **2007 to 2012.**
 
• **C. Rangarajan** was the one who prepared it.
 
• The** total outlay** of the Eleventh Plan has been placed at **Rs.3644718 crore.**
 
• The** Central Government** will provide **Rs.2156571 crore**, and the **State Governments** will contribute **Rs.1488147 crore.**
 
• From **2.13 percent** in the Tenth Plan, the Eleventh Plan proposes raising the growth rate for the **agriculture sector to 4%.**
 
• The** industries and services sectors**' growth targets range from **9 to 11 percent. **
 
• The creation of **7 crore new jobs**, a **10% reduction in poverty**, and guaranteeing that every village has access to **electricity** are all significant goals.
 
• Increased spending on the **infrastructure sector,** which includes **sewage, drinking water, and irrigation**, from 5% of the GDP in 2005–2006 to **9% in 2011–12.**
